AbishekNarasimhan.RavensPort: A tray-resident local proxy that owns the OAuth2 flow for the APIs and MCP servers you use, pools several servers behind one endpoint, and exposes only the tools each AI agent is allowed.

MCP servers are increasingly locked behind OAuth2, but most MCP clients expect a bare HTTP
endpoint with no authentication story. And once an agent is connected to three servers, it sees
all of their tools with no way to say "this agent gets these six."

RavensPort solves both halves. It runs a local reverse proxy on 127.0.0.1, holds the OAuth2
grants and API keys for your upstreams, and lets you compose those upstreams into filtered,
per-agent MCP endpoints. Point an agent at http://127.0.0.1:5559/mcp/<name> and it sees exactly
the toolset you granted it, drawn from as many upstreams as you like, including ones it could
never reach on its own.

ROUTES
Attach a live OAuth2 token or a static API key to every request forwarded to an upstream. Your
client never handles authentication. Credentials can be placed anywhere the upstream expects
them: an Authorization header, any other header, a query parameter, or a request-body field,
with a custom value prefix. A route may attach none, one, or several credentials at once, and
the same credential may appear in more than one place. Tokens refresh automatically ten minutes
before they expire.

FUNNELS
Pool several MCP servers behind a single local endpoint and pick exactly which tools, resources,
and prompts it exposes. Each agent gets its own funnel, so tightening what one agent can reach
never touches another.

AccessData.RegistryViewer: Free Windows forensic registry viewer that lets you view the contents of Windows operating system registries.

AccessData Registry Viewer lets you view the contents of Windows operating system registries. Unlike the Windows Registry Editor, which can only display the current computer's registry, Registry Viewer lets you view registry files from any computer. It provides access to a registry's protected storage, which can contain passwords, usernames, and other information not accessible in Windows Registry Editor. The Full Registry view shows all contents of a registry file, the Common Areas view displays the sections most likely to contain significant data, and the Report view prints only the keys you select. Compatible with 64-bit Windows 10, 11, and Server 2016/2019/2022.

acrosync.acrosync: A native rsync client for Windows

Acrosync for Windows can sync entire folders with any Linux/Mac/NAS without installing server software.
That is because it is the only native Windows implementation of rsync, a powerful folder sync tool that is ubiquitously installed by default in the non-Windows world.

Acrosync for Windows is not dependent on cygwin and it is very easy to install. Just download a small installer and a few clicks later you're ready to go. An ssh client is built-in, so there is no need to setup password-less login for rsync over ssh.

Based on the rsync protocol, Acrosync is smart enough to sync files that only exist or are newer on the source while skipping identical files. Moreover, if only a small portion of a large file is modified, Acrosync will only transfer the modified portion instead of the entire file to save bandwith and improve speed.

Acrosync integrates a file system monitor that can detect file changes. Using the default backup mode, new or modified files will be automatically and almost instantly uploaded to the rsync server. File deletions can also be automatically propagated to the server if the 'propagate deletions' option is selected.

Acrosync for Windows comes with a 15 day trial with all features available.

The all-new Qoder. Powered by agentic coding. You bring the idea, and Qoder gets it done. New Qoder originated from Quest mode in Qoder IDE and is now an independent desktop product. The two products are available side by side and do not replace each other. Choose Qoder IDE if you prefer writing and debugging code directly in an IDE. Choose Qoder if you prefer delegating an end-to-end task to an Agent. Conversation history and memory are stored separately in each product. When getting started, use Data import to bring supported task records, memories, and extension settings from Qoder IDE, Codex, and other apps into your work.

How Qoder works
A typical workflow is:
1. Choose a mode. Coding groups tasks by workspace and provides execution-mode and branch controls; General groups tasks by folder.
2. Describe the goal, expected result, and constraints, then attach files or other context when needed.
3. Select a model and access mode, then send the task. Qoder reads the relevant context, plans the work, and calls tools.
4. Follow commands, file changes, and intermediate results; add requirements or redirect the task when necessary.
5. Inspect the result and run an appropriate validation. For tasks that change code, review the diff before deciding whether to keep, commit, or continue iterating.

Qoder CN 如何工作
一次完整的工作通常包含以下环节：
1. 选择模式。编程按工作区组织任务并提供执行模式和分支选项；通用按文件夹组织任务。
2. 用自然语言说明目标、交付结果与限制，并按需添加文件或其他上下文。
3. 选择模型和授权方式后发送任务。Qoder CN 会读取相关内容、规划步骤并调用工具。
4. 在执行过程中查看命令、文件改动和阶段结果；需要时补充要求或调整方向。
5. 查看结果并完成与任务相符的验证。任务产生代码改动时，应先审查差异，再决定保留、提交或继续迭代。

An AI Coding Assistant for terminal developers: driven by natural language to autonomously read files, invoke tools, and execute commands, with permission-based confirmations before critical operations.

What is Qoder CLI

Qoder CLI is a command-line AI Coding Assistant under the Qoder brand, bringing powerful AI coding capabilities directly to your terminal. Without leaving the command line, you can let Qoder understand your entire codebase, write and modify code, run commands, retrieve information, and complete the full development workflow from exploration to commit.
Qoder CLI is designed for developers who prefer working in the terminal. It operates in a conversational manner: you describe what you want to do in natural language, and Qoder autonomously decides which files to read, which tools to call, and which commands to execute, asking for your confirmation before critical operations based on permission settings.

Core Capabilities

The capabilities of Qoder CLI can be broadly categorized as follows:

Code Understanding and Generation
- Query and edit large codebases, understanding project structure and dependencies across files.
- Support Multimodal Input (e.g., images, PDFs) to generate code from design drafts or screenshots.
- Describe bugs in natural language and let Qoder locate and fix the issues.

Built-in Tools

Alibaba.QoderCLI.CN: 用自然语言驱动的终端 AI 编程助手

面向终端开发者的 AI 编程助手：用自然语言驱动，自主读取文件、调用工具、执行命令，并在关键操作前按权限确认

什么是 Qoder CLI

Qoder CLI 是 Qoder 品牌下的命令行 AI 编程助手，它把强大的 AI 编程能力直接带入你的终端。你不需要离开命令行，就可以让 Qoder 理解整个代码库、编写和修改代码、运行命令、检索资料，并完成从探索到提交的完整开发流程。
Qoder CLI 面向习惯在终端里工作的开发者。它以对话的方式运行：你用自然语言描述想做的事情，Qoder 会自主决定需要读取哪些文件、调用哪些工具、执行哪些命令，并在关键操作前根据权限设置向你确认。

核心能力

Qoder CLI 的能力大致可以分为以下几类：

代码理解与生成
- 查询和编辑大型代码库，跨文件理解项目结构与依赖关系。
- 支持多模态输入（例如图片、PDF），根据设计稿或截图生成代码。
- 用自然语言描述缺陷，让 Qoder 定位并修复问题。

内置工具
- 文件读写与编辑、目录浏览。
- Shell 命令执行。
- 代码搜索（Grep）与文件查找（Glob）。
- Web 搜索与网页抓取，获取实时信息。

自动化与集成
- 自动化 Git 操作、提交、PR 处理等重复性任务。
- 通过 MCP（Model Context Protocol）接入外部服务和自定义工具
- 支持非交互（Headless）模式，在脚本和 CI/CD 流水线中运行

可扩展性
- 通过 Skills、Plugins、Subagents、钩子 和 自定义命令 按团队需要扩展 Qoder CLI 的行为。
- 通过 记忆 与 知识库 让 Qoder 记住项目约定和团队知识。

运行机制
Qoder CLI 的核心是一个 Agent：它接收你的请求，规划步骤，调用工具完成任务，并在过程中不断根据结果调整策略。整个过程围绕四个要素协同运行：
- Agent：负责理解意图、规划步骤、决定下一步动作。
- 工具：Agent 通过工具与你的项目和环境交互，例如读写文件、执行命令、搜索代码。
- 权限：在执行有副作用的操作（如写文件、跑命令）前，Qoder 会依据权限设置请求确认或直接放行。
- 上下文：对话历史、项目说明（AGENTS.md）和长期记忆共同构成 Qoder 完成任务时依赖的背景信息。

多种工作方式
同一个任务可以有不同的完成方式。Qoder CLI 提供多种工作方式，覆盖从即时对话到长时间自动化的不同场景：
- 交互模式：边聊边做，最常用的默认方式。
- Plan（先规划再执行）：先分析问题、确认方案，再动手改代码。
- Goal（持续完成目标）：设定完成条件，让 Qoder 持续工作直到达成目标。
- 定时任务：在指定时间运行一次，或按日历计划重复运行。
- /loop（重复执行）：按固定时间间隔重复运行同一任务。
- Headless（脚本中运行）：在非交互环境中运行，输出结构化结果。

aluigi.QuickBMS: Files extractor and reimporter, archives and file formats parser, advanced tool for reverse engineers and power users, and much more.

QuickBMS uses a minimalistic GUI if the executable is double-clicked (launched normally) or from command-line if launched from the console, by using this second mode or a link to the executable it's possible to activate many useful and advanced options.

Features:
  - open source and multiplatform, tested on Windows (even Win98) and GNU/Linux (x86 and PPC)
  - works from both command-line and GUI (Windows only, just double-click on quickbms.exe)
  - reimport and reimport2 modes for reinjecting the modified files back to the archives
  - support for tons of encryption algorithms, even some proprietary ones
  - support for tons of compression algorithms (over 700), even some proprietary ones
  - support for tons of hashing algorithms
  - support for other types of algorithms (like base64) and/or obfuscations (xor, rot and so on)
  - support for calling DLLs and raw dumped functions with almost any known calling convention
  - support for bits operation and switchable little/big endian
  - simple and dynamic language that allows to make many operations reducing the percentage of archives and formats that can't be supported easily
  - verbose option (-V) that displays all the needed details during reversing and testing of file formats
  - HTML output (-H) that automatically applies colors and names to the fields parsed during the usage of the scripts: example for zip.bms on q3infoboom.zip

Closure 是一款开源、本地优先的 AI 小说创作 IDE，面向网文与长篇小说作者，把大纲、章节、人物与世界观资产卡整合到一个工作区。它以「用户主导创意、AI 执笔与自查」为原则，提供 AI 生成、续写、润色、审阅与可控修改，接入任意 OpenAI 兼容模型，所有创作数据保存在你自己的电脑上。Windows 优先，macOS / Linux 继承自上游架构。Closure 以 AGPL-3.0-or-later 许可证开源（源自 OrisonSpace 的代码保留 Apache-2.0）。

功能亮点

Closure 叠加层：叙事工程

在 OrisonSpace 的写作 IDE 基座之上，Closure 围绕「让 AI 像人类作者一样操控信息差、情绪与欲望」重建了生成管线：
- 多线叙事结构 — 用一张场景图统一管理故事骨架，多条故事线并行推进、互相咬合
- 结构工作台 — 一页总览全书的结构页：因果骨架与编排工作台两区联动，章节轴按卷分带、小地图支持长篇导航；情绪、节奏曲线可作为叠层开关盖上结构图（伏笔叠层规划中）；同构锁步——在任意区域选中一个元素，关联的卡片同步高亮，跨区追一条线索不用来回翻
- 信息差操控 — 记录每个角色知道什么、读者知道什么。审核能发现「角色说了不该知道的」「该揭的伏笔忘了揭」这类漏洞，而作者故意的隐瞒和延迟不会被误报
- 世界事件系统 — 每章写完，自动从正文提取五类变化（物理、认知、情绪、关系、势力），归并出随剧情推进的世界状态快照。关键在于账分两层：事实真相与读者此刻所知分开记录，两者的差距就是你的伏笔库存——该埋的没埋、该揭的没揭，系统看得见。后续章节动笔时，角色此刻知道什么、关系走到哪了，自动进入写手上下文
- 情绪工程化闭环 — 每场戏先定好想要的情绪，写完自动检查情绪是否真的落了地，没落地就打回修
- 写章链 — 写一章的完整流程：对话下意图、导演核对设定、装配上下文、写手成稿、检查点停下等你过目、审核修订、落章后回来汇报。每一步都暂停等人，方向盘始终在你手里
- 双层编排架构 — 战略层是对话里的总指挥（你在环、随时改向），战术层是带显式契约的节点链（依赖不漏、工件流转不靠提示词隐性携带）；链段只把摘要带回对话，内部过程不占用你的上下文；检查点可暂停、可恢复、可改稿重跑
- 写手两阶段成稿 — 写手不是一口气生成：先自查上下文缺口，列出调查清单，资料员逐条核实后才开始动笔。上下文预算耗尽时按降级梯裁剪，故事骨架、全书目录、可查指针永远不裁
- 联网研究 — 写作前先查资料：多家搜索供应商可配（Tavily / Bocha / …

piz 解决一个问题：你知道想做什么，但记不住具体命令。用自然语言描述你的需求，piz 自动翻译成适合当前系统和 Shell 的命令。
核心功能
- 自然语言转命令 — 描述需求，得到精确命令
- 多 LLM 后端 — 支持 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、Ollama + 12 个 OpenAI 兼容供应商（DeepSeek、硅基流动、OpenRouter、Moonshot、智谱 GLM、百度千帆、阿里 DashScope、Mistral、Together、Minimax、字节 BytePlus 等）
- 安全加固 — 三层防护：Prompt 层拒绝非命令输入、注入检测（base64 载荷、环境变量泄露、反弹 Shell、curl 配置攻击）、正则危险分级
- 危险命令检测 — 正则 + LLM 双重防护，危险命令强制二次确认，无法跳过
- 命令解释 — piz -e 'command' 逐项拆解命令含义
- 命令纠错 — piz fix 自动诊断并修复失败命令，支持自动重试（最多 3 次）
- 交互式对话 — piz chat 多轮对话模式，支持 /help、/clear、/history 命令和历史持久化
- 多候选命令 — -n 参数生成多个命令方案，自主选择最优方案
- 本地缓存 — SQLite 缓存 + TTL 过期 + LRU 淘汰 + 最大条目数限制，重复查询秒返回
- 执行历史 — piz history 查看和搜索所有执行过的命令
- Shell 集成 — piz init <shell> 生成 Shell 包装函数，使 cd/export/source 在当前 Shell 中正确生效（bash、zsh、fish、PowerShell），内置便捷别名（p、pf、pc）
- Eval 模式 — --eval 将确认后的命令输出给 Shell 包装函数执行
- Shell 补全 — 支持 bash、zsh、fish、PowerShell 自动补全
- 管道模式 — --pipe 纯命令输出，便于脚本集成
- 多语言界面 — 中文、英文，安全提示信息全面国际化
- 跨平台 — Windows (PowerShell/cmd)、macOS、Linux (bash/zsh/fish)，零侵入编码处理（不修改 chcp/OutputEncoding）
- 交互式配置 — 首次运行自动引导，内置供应商预设，无需手动编辑配置
- NO_COLOR 支持 — 尊重 NO_COLOR 环境变量

aube.aube:
aube is a package manager for Node.js projects. It uses pnpm-style isolated node_modules for fast, disk-efficient installs.

Existing projects keep their lockfile format. aube reads and writes pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock, and bun.lock in place. New projects without a supported lockfile get aube-lock.yaml.

Why Try It
- Fast installs. Warm installs are about 8x faster than pnpm and about 5x faster than Bun in the current benchmarks. Repeat test commands run up to 35x faster than pnpm and up to 5x faster than Bun.
- Existing lockfiles. Reads and writes pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock, and bun.lock in place.
- Cheap repeat commands. aubr test, aube test, and aube exec vitest auto-install when dependencies are stale, then skip that work when nothing changed. aubx uses a local binary when one is installed, or a throwaway environment for one-off tools.
- Less disk use. A global content-addressable store lets projects share package files instead of keeping a full copy of the same dependencies in every checkout.
- Secure defaults. Out of the box, exotic transitive deps are blocked, lifecycle scripts wait for approval, trust downgrades fail at resolve, and brand-new releases sit in a 24h cooling window. One paranoid: true line adds the build jail and turns the soft gates into hard fails.

- AudioCodes employee (FAE / Support / R&D) creates "template file" and matching "ui file". The former contains device configuration with specific parts of it replaced with %tags%. The latter contains definition of end-user interface that is used to get values for these %tags%.
- The above two files (.template + .ui) are delivered to customer and placed in the same directory
- Customer opens the wizard and chooses the specific .template file that he wants to work with
- The wizard prompts customer to enter values for template-specific %tags% - as per the .ui file
- When the customer completes all configuration screens, the wizard generates device configuration (INI or CLI) by expanding all %tags% and processing all #macros in the template

AXIS Streaming Assistant is an application that bridges video streams from IP cameras into a Windows desktop application to enable broadcasting or conferencing use-cases.
